04 FAQ

Asked before
every order.

Six answers that cover 90% of technical discussions. The rest — with an engineer, not a salesperson.

Ask an engineer

Rule of thumb: travel beyond 200 m or speeds above 120 m/min favor conductor rail; festoon wins on short runs and tight budgets. Our engineers evaluate duty cycle, environment and fleet standardization before quoting — a sizing answer within 4 working hours.

Inspect brush wear every 500 operating hours; typical carbon life is 8,000–25,000 h depending on dust load and alignment. Akkap Connect customers receive predictive wear alerts from collector telemetry — replacements ship before failure, not after.

Yes — roughly a third of our projects are retrofits. We survey on site, design adapter brackets for existing girder drilling and phase changeovers so production never stops. Adapter kits cover the most common OEM rail geometries.

Every export batch ships with GOST-R / EAC conformity, calibration sheets and material certificates to EN 10204 3.1. TÜV type tests and customer factory audits are welcome at any time.

Standard rail and collectors: 2–3 weeks ex works. Custom voltages, brackets or curved tracks: 6–8 weeks including prototype approval. A-stock spare parts dispatch within 48 h from six regional hubs.

24 months or 10,000 operating hours, whichever comes first. Extendable with Uptime+ contracts: thermographic inspection, brush exchange program, 4 h remote response and guaranteed 48 h parts logistics across 40 countries.
